skills.description: Output only. Skills the agent possesses, often obtained from the A2A Agent Card.

agentId.description: Output only. A stable, globally unique identifier for agents.

displayName.description: Output only. The display name of the agent, often obtained from the A2A Agent Card.

card.description: Output only. Full Agent Card payload, when available.

name.description: Identifier. The resource name of an Agent. Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/agents/{agent}`.

version.description: Output only. The version of the Agent, often obtained from the A2A Agent Card. Empty if Agent Card has no version or agent is not an A2A Agent.

Agent.description: Represents an Agent. "A2A" below refers to the Agent-to-Agent protocol.

Location.description: A resource that represents a Google Cloud location.

locationId.description: The canonical id for this location. For example: `"us-east1"`.

metadata.description: Service-specific metadata. For example the available capacity at the given location.

additionalProperties.description: Properties of the object. Contains field @type with type URL.

labels.description: Cross-service attributes for the location. For example {"cloud.googleapis.com/region": "us-east1"}

displayName.description: The friendly name for this location, typically a nearby city name. For example, "Tokyo".

name.description: Resource name for the location, which may vary between implementations. For example: `"projects/example-project/locations/us-east1"`

content.description: Optional. The content of the endpoint spec. Reserved for future use.

type.description: Required. The type of the endpoint spec content.
enumDescriptions: There is no spec for the Endpoint. The `content` field must be empty.

identifier.description: The identifier of the source Agent. Format: * `urn:agent:{publisher}:{namespace}:{name}`

Protocol.description: Represents the protocol of an Agent.

interfaces.description: Output only. The connection details for the Agent.

type.description: Output only. The type of the protocol.
enumDescriptions: The interfaces point to an A2A Agent following the A2A specification.
Agent does not follow any standard protocol.

protocolVersion.description: Output only. The version of the protocol, for example, the A2A Agent Card version.

ListBindingsResponse.description: Message for response to listing Bindings

bindings.description: The list of Binding resources matching the parent and filter criteria in the request. Each Binding resource follows the format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/bindings/{binding}`.

nextPageToken.description: A token identifying a page of results the server should return. Used in page_token.

protocolBinding.description: Required. The protocol binding of the interface.

Interface.description: Represents the connection details for an Agent or MCP Server.

ListServicesResponse.description: Message for response to listing Services

services.description: The list of Service resources matching the parent and filter criteria in the request. Each Service resource follows the format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/services/{service}`.

nextPageToken.description: A token identifying a page of results the server should return. Used in page_token.

content.description: Optional. The content of the Agent spec in the JSON format. This payload is validated against the schema for the specified type. The content size is limited to `10KB`.

type.description: Required. The type of the agent spec content.
enumDescriptions: There is no spec for the Agent. The `content` field must be empty.
